summary: Completed testing of Telegram Utility-first architecture (U-2 to U-5). All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend utility mode default, toggle functionality, utility columns, growth badges, and sector heatmap all implemented and functioning properly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/telegram-intel/sector/overview returns 4 sectors with market summary
Backend: Utility mode stats working (avgUtility: 52, avgGrowth30: 7.98, avgEngagement: 0.1276)
Frontend: /telegram shows Utility mode as default (no mode param in URL)
Frontend: Mode toggle working - [Utility] [Advanced] [Momentum] tabs functional
Frontend: Utility columns present: Utility | Growth | ER | Stability | Original | Fraud
Frontend: Growth badges working: Hot (🔥), Rising (⚡), Cooling (🧊) badges visible
Frontend: /telegram/sectors loads Sector Heatmap with 4 sectors
Frontend: Sector table shows VC, NFT, TRADING, NEWS categories with metrics
Frontend: Market summary cards display total channels (5), avg utility (48), avg growth (+6.5%)
Integration: Frontend properly consuming backend utility and sector APIs
